queued.work: Swap the CDN highlight.js for <ui-code> on docs pages

items.title: Where do throwaway review pages live
items.details: The doc preview serves only files under the checkout's git root.  Options: (A) epics/<name>/review/, ignored by git (recommended): served by the page server already, next to the doc they explain.  (B) the scratchpad: outside the root, so the preview can't show it.  (C) packages/docs/tmp/: one shared folder, collisions between epics.

items.title: plan-doc check fails on a stub doc: empty Phases can't stick
items.details: check-spell scrolls each top-level section to the middle of the screen and checks its title sticks.  A stub's #phases is empty, so it's too short:  'ui-section #phases not stuck at the top'.  Every new /epic hits it until the first add-phase.  Fix: skip the stick check for a section shorter than the viewport, or give an empty #phases a placeholder line.
items.recommendation: Skip the stick check for sections shorter than the viewport

items.title: yarn -s is not a yarn 4 flag
items.details: Scripts written as 'yarn -s plan-doc ...' print yarn's whole usage and exit 1.  Yarn 4 dropped -s / --silent for scripts.  No recommendation yet: either document it in PAPERCUTS or grep the skills for 'yarn -s'.

items.title: Doc preview loses scroll position on reload
items.details: Reviewed 2026-10-01: accepted, it re-lands on the hash.

items.title: Log timestamps use local time without a zone
items.details: A log read from another time zone shows the wrong hour.

items.title: plan-doc open picked the focused window
Backfill sees only transcripts titled with the epic's name
items.details: A session renamed by hand, or one that discussed the epic under another title, is missed.  Accept, or also scan sessions whose cwd is the epic's worktree.
items.recommendation: Also scan sessions whose cwd is the epic's worktree

items.title: Modals cap at 4 options
items.details: AskUserQuestion takes 2-4 options plus a free-text Other.  Shapes every modal in the review.
